lead: Make an AI UGC video ad for the app or gadget you sell. Skip the creator hunt, the outreach, and the wait for a shoot.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot before I can make an install ad?
faq.a: No. Upload one screenshot or photo, or paste a product link, and download the ad. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300. Premium is $63 for 600. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do I need editing skills to make the ad?
faq.a: No. A spoken voice and captions come with the clip, and you can fix them in the editor before you export.

faq.q: Can I make several ads from one screenshot?
faq.a: Yes. One screenshot can become an unboxing, a button press, and a desk scene.

faq.q: Which apps and gadgets can I turn into an ad?
faq.a: Apps, speakers, cables, docks, and other products with a clear screen or shape. Use that product's own photo, and name one action.

faq.q: Can I make the ad without hiring a creator?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one photo or paste a link, pick an AI avatar, and pay the credits shown before the job. Post the clip as an ad.

faq.q: Will the clip invent my specs?
faq.a: No. Type the battery life, the wattage, or the feature list yourself in the editor or on the listing, then check them against the real product.

faq.q: Can I run the clip as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in paid ads. Do not overstate how the product performs.

faq.q: What video shape should I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a square, and 16:9 for a wide page. Use 4:3 or 3:4 when the page asks for them.

faq.q: Can the ad include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Pick an AI avatar and the clip can include a spoken line and captions. Launch it on TikTok or Meta, or download it and post it yourself.
